tools.name: kb_answer
tools.description: Look up the answer to a question about the company, its research, or its products in the official knowledge base. Always use this before answering factual questions.

tools.name: sar_lookup
tools.description: Look up a phone model's FCC-reported SAR values (head, body, hotspot; cellular-only and with Wi-Fi on) from RF Safe's public SAR database. Speak the numbers briefly; never read the URLs aloud.

phone.description: brand and model, e.g. iPhone 17 Pro Max

tools.name: sar_ranking
tools.description: List the LOWEST-SAR (lowest radiation) phones in RF Safe's public SAR database, ranked by FCC-reported SAR. Use for questions like "what is the lowest radiation phone", "which phone has the lowest SAR", or "lowest SAR Samsung". Report the top phones with their head and body SAR in W/kg against the 1.6 limit, and offer the ranking page.

metric.description: combined (head + body, default), head, or body

brand.description: optional brand filter, e.g. Apple, Samsung

tools.name: note_unanswered
tools.description: Call this whenever you could not answer a caller's question from kb_answer / website_lookup results (no passage, or the passages did not cover it). question.description: the caller's question, in a few words, no personal details
